style: Classic European adventure-comic illustration in the clean-line style, for kids around ten: uniform-weight black ink outlines, flat bright colours with no gradients and no texture, very little shading, clear readable silhouettes, carefully drawn machines with neat panel lines and rivets; a retro-adventure feel with lively expressions. Natural proportions and believable, realistic space hardware; not chibi, not big-eyed, not cute or fluffy — friendly and capable, never scary. No text, no lettering, no logos, no flags, no watermarks.
styleSheet: A style sheet on a plain white background, four sticker characters standing side by side, all facing slightly to the left, whole bodies visible: an astronaut woman in a white-and-orange spacesuit, her face clearly visible through a clear helmet visor, waving; a humanoid helper robot whose face is an LED screen showing a friendly smile; a six-wheeled science rover with a mast camera and a drill arm; and a tall white rocket with fins standing upright. Plus a small swatch of lunar ground (grey dust, a small crater, a rock) in the bottom corner. Consistent style, palette and line weight across everything.

stickers.prompt: An adult woman astronaut in a modern lunar spacesuit of today's Moon missions (like the new suits made for the Artemis landings): white with a few light-grey panels and thin orange accents at the joints, a slim life-support backpack, sturdy boots and gloves, a round clear bubble helmet with a thin collar ring, no logos, no flags, no name tags, no text. Her face is clearly visible through the clear helmet (warm brown skin, dark hair tied back), friendly and capable, a small confident smile. She stands relaxed with her arms down, ready to do something, whole body visible, facing slightly left.
stickers.faceNote: The face is seen through a clear helmet visor: the visor's rim, its shine and the hair stay exactly as they are; only the face's expression changes.

stickers.prompt: An adult man astronaut in a modern lunar spacesuit of today's Moon missions (like the new suits made for the Artemis landings): white with a few light-grey panels and thin orange accents at the joints, a slim life-support backpack, sturdy boots and gloves, a round clear bubble helmet with a thin collar ring, no logos, no flags, no name tags, no text. His face is clearly visible through the clear helmet (light olive skin, short dark hair, a neat short beard), friendly and calm, a small smile. He stands relaxed with his arms down, ready to do something, whole body visible, facing slightly left.
stickers.faceNote: The face is seen through a clear helmet visor: the visor's rim, its shine and the hair stay exactly as they are; only the face's expression changes. He keeps his short beard exactly as it is.

stickers.prompt: A tall, sleek, modern reusable spaceship standing upright on its tail, like the stainless-steel ships being built today for flights to the Moon: a smooth shiny silver steel body, a rounded nose, two small flaps near the nose and two larger flaps near the base, black heat-shield tiles along one side, short landing legs, a few small windows near the top. Realistic and modern; no logos, no flags, no text.

A compact lunar oxygen plant: a sturdy white and orange machine on short legs, with a small hopper for moon soil on top, a row of round green-and-blue gas tanks along its side joined by neat silver pipes, a little round window glowing faintly orange where the soil is baked, and two small round gauges. Realistic, clean and modern, like real space hardware; no logos, no text, no smoke or steam.

A modern crew lunar lander of the kind being built today for landing astronauts on the Moon: a tall white-and-light-grey cylindrical body standing on four wide landing legs with round footpads, a crew cabin with a few small windows near the top, a long solar panel along one side, a slim ladder down to the ground, small thruster pods. Realistic, modern, not the 1960s Apollo lander; no logos, no flags, no text.

A modern crew space capsule flying in space, like the cone-shaped capsules that carry astronauts to the Moon today: a white-and-silver cone with a few small windows, joined at its base to a white cylindrical service module with an engine bell and four long solar-panel wings spread out in an X. Realistic; no logos, no flags, no text.

A supply pod: a squat cylindrical cargo capsule in white with orange stripes, a closed hinged lid on top, small thruster nozzles around its base and four short landing feet, standing on its feet, whole pod visible, facing slightly left.

A tiny CubeSat satellite flying in space: a small box the size of a shoebox with gold-and-silver panels, two small blue solar panels unfolded like wings and a thin antenna. Realistic; no logos, no text.

A communications satellite: a boxy body wrapped in gold foil with a white dish antenna and two long blue solar panels folded flat against its sides, a few thin antennas, floating, whole satellite visible, facing slightly left.

A space station: a long white truss with several white cylindrical modules and four pairs of long blue-and-gold solar wings and white radiators, seen from a little below, floating, whole station visible.

A deep-space probe: a small boxy body in gold foil with a big white dish antenna on the front, long thin booms and a small instrument platform, floating with its dish facing left, whole probe visible.

A small, faraway spiral galaxy seen at a slight tilt, like the Andromeda galaxy: a soft, glowing warm-white centre and two delicate pale-blue spiral arms made of a mist of tiny stars, with a few faint dark dust lanes. Simple and soft, not too detailed — a gentle glowing swirl. Realistic; no planets, no other stars around it, no text.

A solid, lumpy, potato-shaped asteroid of grey-brown rock, its surface rough and slightly bumpy with a few small scuffs and shallow dents, and NO holes or deep craters punched through it. Realistic; no text.

A pressurised crew rover for the Moon, like a camper van for astronauts: a rounded white-and-orange cabin with big front windows, six big mesh wheels, a docking hatch at the back, a small solar panel and an antenna on the roof, headlights. Realistic, like the real crew rovers being designed today; no people inside visible, no logos, no text.

The six-wheeled science rover from the style sheet: a white-and-orange body, a tall mast with a camera head, a folded robotic arm with a drill, big ridged wheels, whole vehicle visible, facing slightly left.

An open two-seat moon buggy with four big wire-mesh wheels, a light tubular frame, a small dish antenna and two empty seats, white and orange with grey, nobody in it, whole vehicle visible, facing slightly left.

A lunar excavator robot: a compact tracked vehicle in white and yellow with two big drum-shaped digging buckets on short arms at the front and the back, both raised, and a small camera mast, whole vehicle visible, facing slightly left.

A big construction printer that builds walls on the Moon from moon dust: a sturdy white-and-orange gantry frame on four short legs, a printing head with a nozzle hanging from it, laying down a short curved wall of grey moon-dust concrete layer by layer underneath, a hopper of grey dust on top. Realistic, like the real machines being designed to build on the Moon; no logos, no text.

A small lunar seismometer that listens for moonquakes: a squat drum-shaped instrument wrapped in shiny gold foil, standing on three short legs, with a little solar panel on a stand beside it and a cable between them. Realistic, like the real ones left on the Moon; no text.
A solar panel on a stand: a single square panel of dark blue cells in a silver frame, tilted up, on a folding silver tripod stand with small feet, whole panel visible, facing slightly left.

An inflatable greenhouse dome: a round white-and-clear inflated dome with soft ribs, rows of green plants visible inside, a small airlock door with a round window and a little solar panel beside it, its lights off, whole dome visible, facing slightly left.

A seedling in a sealed grow pod: a small clear glass dome on a round white base with a violet grow-light ring (switched off), inside a little green sprout with two open leaves and a third leaf still curled up, whole pod visible.

A zinnia flower growing safely inside a small sealed plant-growth box like the ones astronauts grow flowers in: a see-through clear box with a white frame and rounded corners, closed on every side, a soft pink-purple grow light glowing in its lid, and inside it one bright orange zinnia bloom with layered petals and a yellow centre, a few green leaves on a straight stem, rooted in a small white pillow of soil at the bottom. Realistic, like the real plant-growth units on the space station; no text, no logos.
A chunk of water ice: a jagged, frosty block of pale blue-white ice with streaks of grey moon dust frozen into it and a few sharp glints, whole chunk visible.
A single small Moon rock sample: a rounded, slightly angular light-grey rock speckled with tiny white glittering crystals. Realistic; no text.

expressions.prompt: happy — a big, open, confident smile, the eyes smiling (curved upward, crinkled with joy), cheeks lifted.
a little sad — eyebrows tilted up in the middle, eyes soft and a bit droopy, a small downturned mouth. Gentle, not crying, no tears.
fast asleep — both eyes peacefully closed as soft curved lines, a small relaxed mouth, calm.
amazed — eyes wide open and round, eyebrows raised high, a small round open "o" mouth. Amazed and excited, never scared.

scene.background: The surface of the Moon seen from a child's height, a wide landscape: grey dusty ground with pebbles and small craters across the lower part, gently rolling; a long, low, jagged ridge of grey mountains along the horizon; on the horizon right of the middle, the small white domes and modules of a distant moon base with a few lit windows; a black sky above with the Earth hanging in it, blue and white and half lit, left of the middle. On the ground left of the middle, a flat hexagonal landing pad of grey metal plates with yellow markings and small lights around its edge, seen in low perspective as a wide, flattened hexagon, empty. On the ground right of the middle, a wide, shallow crater with a raised rim, a flattened oval seen from low down. The middle of the ground stays open where stickers will be placed. No people, no robots, no vehicles, no rockets.
scene.foreground: The nearest elements only, kept slim so most of the picture shows the landscape behind them: at the very left edge, the end of a white-and-orange habitat module close to us, cut off by the left edge of the picture and taking no more than the left eighth of its width — its curved white hull with orange bands, a round airlock hatch with a porthole facing us, and a short ladder from the hatch down to the ground, standing on short legs; at the very right edge, a narrow outcrop of dark rock with a slim lattice radio mast and a small dish on top, cut off by the right edge and taking no more than the right eighth of the width; along the very bottom, a few grey rocks and some dust. The whole centre and the sky stay empty and transparent.
scene.foregroundWideOwn: the habitat module at the very left edge of this wide picture, cut off by its left edge and taking no more than the left eighth of its width, with the airlock hatch, porthole and ladder facing us; the rock outcrop with the radio mast and dish at the very right edge, cut off by its right edge and taking no more than the right eighth of its width; a few grey rocks and dust along the very bottom across the whole width. Nothing else: the rest of the picture stays transparent so the landscape shows.

sky.description: the black starry sky above the far ridge, between the habitat and the radio mast, clear of the Earth

plain.description: the open grey ground of the plain, in front of the far ridge

pad.description: the hexagonal landing pad left of the middle, beside the habitat

crater.description: the wide, shallow crater right of the middle

hatch.description: the foot of the ladder up to the habitat's round airlock hatch, at the left edge

mast.description: the foot of the radio mast with its dish, on the rocks at the right edge: someone there faces the mast

edits.prompt: Plain black space with a few small, distant, unlit stars, exactly like the rest of the sky around it. Nothing else: no planet, no moon, no glow.

The Earth rising over the far grey ridge: a blue-and-white planet with white clouds, half lit from the left and dark on the right, its lower part hidden behind the jagged grey mountains of the horizon. Crisp and calm, with no glow around it. The ridge in front of it stays as it is.

notes.stickers: Every sticker faces slightly left, whole subject visible, realistic and modern (no aliens, no robots, no sci-fi): real hardware of today's Moon missions. No logos, flags or text anywhere. Edit prompts freely; a changed prompt re-renders only that sticker.
notes.expressions: Faces for the two astronauts only, through their helmets; spacecraft, machines and objects have none.
